Run a command in a sandbox inside a workspace, with an identity of its own

## Usage

```console
coder run [flags] <workspace> [-- command...]
```

## Description

```console
Run a command as a workload: in a sandbox that the workspace's daemon creates, without a workspace build. The workload gets its own identity, sponsored by you. It can do nothing in Coder unless you give it scopes, and it never receives your credentials. The command's output is streamed and its exit code returned.
  - Run a command and see who it is:

     $ coder run my-workspace -- coder identity

  - Let a workload list your workspaces:

     $ coder run my-workspace --scope workspace:read --scope template:read -- coder list

  - List the workloads of a workspace:

     $ coder run --list my-workspace

  - Remove a workload:

     $ coder run --remove workload-1a2b3c4d my-workspace
```

## Options

### --name

| Property | Value               |
|----------|---------------------|
| Type     | <code>string</code> |

A name for the workload.

### --scope

| Property | Value                     |
|----------|---------------------------|
| Type     | <code>string-array</code> |

A permission the workload may use on your behalf, as an API token scope such as workspace:read. Repeat it for several. Without any, the workload can do nothing in Coder.

### --image

| Property | Value               |
|----------|---------------------|
| Type     | <code>string</code> |

The image for the workload's sandbox. Defaults to the one the workspace's daemon is configured with.

### --agent

| Property | Value               |
|----------|---------------------|
| Type     | <code>string</code> |

The workspace daemon to run the workload in, by name. Only needed when the workspace has several.

### -d, --detach

| Property | Value             |
|----------|-------------------|
| Type     | <code>bool</code> |

Start the workload and print its name instead of following its output.

### -l, --list

| Property | Value             |
|----------|-------------------|
| Type     | <code>bool</code> |

List the workspace's workloads instead of running one.

### --remove

| Property | Value               |
|----------|---------------------|
| Type     | <code>string</code> |

Remove the named workload instead of running one.
